# Native-reader fixtures

`sample.pdf` and `sample.pptx` were generated specifically for this project on
2026-09-08 using ReportLab and python-pptx. They contain synthetic Chinese quote
amounts (12800 and 25800), no user data. The real Grok Build 1.0.13 read_file probe
read both correctly. These fixtures may be freely used with the project tests.
